summary: Frontend-only retest of the brand refresh fixes from iteration 135, checked in the UI and in the code. Most items pass. Leftovers: (a) cart chip labels render as 'BSHOP'/'BFOOD' because of CSS uppercase; (b) the CheckoutPage and CartPage chips still use 'SHOP'/'FOOD'/'MART' labels with amber/red background tints; (c) the hero illustration on the partner landing page (/Sell-on-baked) still uses the old FOOD/AUTO/IMMO colours, and the partner-portal registry, partner landing cards and /search page still have old bAUTO/bIMMO colours; (d) the mobile bFOOD hero eyebrow renders 'BFOOD'.
passed_checks: (1) Website dark mode: the bAUTO/bIMMO tabs use badge-on-dark.png. Light mode: all tabs use badge-on-light.png.
(2) Dark-mode module logo alt text is bMART/bFOOD/bSHOP/bSEND.

(3) /search?q=burger: the group header reads 'bFOOD · 20' in rgb(242,105,36) with orange prices. In the dropdown the group label is 'bFOOD (6)' (text-transform none) with orange prices. MODULE_META has shop #1D9BF0 and send #FCC44C in both files.

(4) Shop-only cart drawer: the chip is blue #1D9BF0 and cart-drawer-checkout has bg #1D9BF0 with white text. Food chip is #F26924 and cart-drawer-food-checkout bg is #F26924. A mixed cart gives a neutral #E5E7EB checkout button.
(5) The home hero pill reads 'bMART'. Admin dashboard module cards and the sidebar read bMART/bFOOD/bSHOP/bSEND/bAUTO/bIMMO in the correct colours.

(6) SHOP_ACCENT=#1D9BF0 in AdminShopCatalog, Products, Attributes and Approvals. MOD_ACCENT shop is #1D9BF0 in AdminSuppliersShell and AdminSupplierApplications. In moduleRegistry.js bSHOP is #1D9BF0 and bFOOD is #F26924. On the partner landing page the bFOOD/bSHOP cards are orange/blue. (Code verified; the admin shop pages were not opened in the UI.)

(7) Mobile preview: the empty cart says 'Ajoutez des courses bMART, des plats bFOOD ou des articles bSHOP...'. Module search placeholders are 'Rechercher sur BAKED · bFOOD' and '· bSHOP' (Explorer too). Onboarding slide 2 title is 'bFOOD, bMART, bSHOP et bSEND'.
Regression: website home, /food, /shop and /send load in dark and light mode with no page errors. Mobile preview home (guest), the bFOOD and bSHOP module homes and Explorer load.

ui_bugs.issue: The chip className has 'uppercase', so the labels show as 'BSHOP'/'BFOOD' in the drawer (and on /paiement, which reuses the drawer). The mart label is 'MART' with no b-prefix. Remove 'uppercase' and use 'bMART'.
chipLabel is still 'SHOP'/'FOOD'/'MART' with CSS uppercase. chipBg for shop is rgba(251,191,36,.15) (amber tint) and for food rgba(239,68,68,.15) (red tint). Only chipFg was updated.

The badge label is 'SHOP'/'MART' (uppercase, no b). The shop background and border are still the amber rgba(251,191,36,...). Note: /cart currently redirects home and opens the drawer, so this may be legacy code.

issues: The HeroEcosystemIllustration (lines 280-284) has FOOD #FF6B6B (red), AUTO #9B87F5 and IMMO #F97316 (orange). These should be #F26924, #FF4C52 and #A659FF. You can see it in the UI: the food icon is red and the immo icon is orange.
The module cards (lines 414 and 421) have bAUTO #9B87F5 and bIMMO #F97316.
In light mode the top-left logo and the centre hub 'bakēd' logo are white on white and nearly invisible.
autobaked is #9B87F5 and immobaked is #EC4899. They should be #FF4C52 and #A659FF.
auto is still #9B87F5 and immo #EC4899. The dropdown already uses #FF4C52/#A659FF, so the two files do not match.
The fee rows read 'Frais de livraison (SHOP)' / '(FOOD)' with no b-prefix.
The hero eyebrow renders as 'BFOOD' (uppercase transform). The website /food eyebrow correctly shows 'bFOOD'.
The 'Poulet' category image is broken (only the alt text shows) in both themes.
The demo shop product images (e.g. 'Premium Pièces & accessoires moto' and 'Weekend Autres accessoires auto') are broken or empty.

issues: The bSEND #FCC44C text wordmark on white has low contrast (about 1.6:1). Consider a darker shade for the text, as the mobile accentText does.
The platform logo is nearly invisible (pre-existing; noted as requested).

PartnerLandingApp.jsx: change FOOD #FF6B6B to #F26924, AUTO #9B87F5 to #FF4C52 and IMMO #F97316 to #A659FF (hero illustration and cards)
moduleRegistry.js and GlobalSearchResultsPage.jsx: auto should be #FF4C52 and immo #A659FF
Mobile bFOOD hero eyebrow: remove the uppercase transform so it shows 'bFOOD'
critical_code_review_comments: Module colours and labels are still hardcoded in many files (search page, dropdown, cart, checkout, partner registry, partner landing). Use lib/modules getModule() as the single source of truth to avoid drift like the auto/immo mismatch.
Several brand labels sit inside elements with the 'uppercase' class. Any b-prefixed label must not be uppercased.
